authorized_scope: Implement and computationally calibrate the three-role measurement workflow, then assess all saved generated direct and pipeline task conditions. Do not regenerate historical tasks.

models.independence_limit: Two OpenAI model series, not independent model families. Configured endpoint advertises non-OpenAI model names but DeepSeek-V3.1 and qwen3-32b probes returned DeploymentNotFound. No SwissAI credentials are configured.

prerequisites: Use each run's saved learner history, never current generator defaults or approach-derived prerequisites. Missing history gives accessibility Unclear and approach limits Not assessed.

references.provenance: Assistant-prepared provisional mathematical/text references. No human reviewer available.
references.claim_limit: Computational reference checks and inter-model consistency are not human calibration, learner fidelity or educational validation.

development.stop: Initial development plus at most one targeted clarification/rerun, then freeze. Preserve disagreements and reference ambiguity; do not force agreement.

transfer.claim_limit: Reserved from this instrument's development; existing expert topics were previously inspected, so not untouched-topic validation.

reporting.approach_counts: Supplementary model-identified methods, not student frequency or complete diversity.
reporting.original_generation_failures: Inventory separately; task absence is not a failed educational judgment.
